text:
jin: Quick thread 0mins. Onboarding OREX adapter overlay v2 -> int4 build shows currency formatting drift: cents sometimes dropped and comma placement inconsistent.
marta: Oof. Example?
jin: Input: "Total: $1,200.00" -> model sometimes emits "Total: 1200.0" or "Total: 1,200". Float32/int8 are stable. Failures spike only with int4 after adapter merge.
oliver: Customer flagged in acceptance tests, blocking billing flow.
sophia: Can you repro locally and share the minimal commands?
jin: Repro: `python tools/eval_quickpack.py --cust orex --adapter overlay-v2 --model base-7b-q4 --quant int4 --tasks invoice-format`
Tokenizer snapshot before merge:
`tokenizer.encode("$1,200.00") -> [5021, 8, 345, 13, 2201, 5]`
After merge+int4 load some runs drop token id `13` (comma).
marta: Sounds like vocab id remap during merge + quant init. Two options: pin punctuation ids in merge, or post-fix with regex. Prefer merge pinning.
jin: Drafted pin-list patch + small int4 warmstart on validation set. PR: https://github.com/redwood/adapter-merges/pull/331
eval-bot: smoke run after PR applied -> invoice-format int4: 87/100 (was 62/100). Noted one date-format regression. Full CI queued.
oliver: I'll coordinate a dedicated run on customer dataset when CI green. ETA this afternoon.
sophia: Product asks for numeric fidelity for billing routes; add unit test to quickpack to assert two decimal places on currency outputs.
marta: adding test and onboarding ticket ONB-789.
jin: will post canary logs once deployed. :rocket:
